prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Nilesh V., Mahesh bhai, Subhash bhai, Nilesh bhai.
The chat covers 13/03/26, 6:30 pm to 13/03/26, 8:30 pm. It must have exactly 23 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
13/03/26, 7:27 pm - Nilesh bhai: Mahesh bhai, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
13/03/26, 6:30 pm - Subhash bhai: Aaj ka payment settlement ho gaya kya sabhi ka?
13/03/26, 6:35 pm - Mahesh bhai: Haan Subhash bhai, mostly sab clear hai.
13/03/26, 6:40 pm - Nilesh V.: Ek customer ka call aaya tha, bol raha tha refund chahiye.
13/03/26, 6:44 pm - Nilesh bhai: Kaunsa customer Nilesh V? QR code scam wala issue hai kya?
13/03/26, 6:48 pm - Nilesh V.: Haan, bol raha hai UPI pin daala par paise kat gaye.
13/03/26, 6:52 pm - Subhash bhai: Use bolo bank complaint raise kare, humare side se system error bata do.
13/03/26, 6:58 pm - Mahesh bhai: Main entry check karta hoon portal pe.
13/03/26, 7:05 pm - Nilesh bhai: Customer ko bolo 24 hours me auto refund ho jayega.
13/03/26, 7:10 pm - Nilesh V.: Theek hai, maine wahi bola hai usko.
13/03/26, 7:15 pm - Mahesh bhai: Transaction ID 883921 wala transaction reflect ho raha hai.
13/03/26, 7:20 pm - Subhash bhai: Iska money kahan transfer hua hai?
13/03/26, 7:24 pm - Mahesh bhai: Wo secondary wallet account me credit dikha raha hai.
13/03/26, 7:27 pm - Nilesh bhai: Mahesh bhai, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
13/03/26, 7:32 pm - Mahesh bhai: Samjh gaya bhai, logs clear kar raha hoon.
13/03/26, 7:38 pm - Subhash bhai: Koi screenshot ya SMS trace toh nahi bacha na?
13/03/26, 7:43 pm - Nilesh V.: Customer dobara call kar raha hai, bol raha hai cyber cell jaa raha hai.
13/03/26, 7:48 pm - Nilesh bhai: Call mat uthao abhi, number block list me daal do.
13/03/26, 7:55 pm - Mahesh bhai: Server log se entry hatado fast.
13/03/26, 8:02 pm - Subhash bhai: Kal subah tak matter cool down ho jayega.
13/03/26, 8:10 pm - Nilesh V.: Theek hai, main sim swap wala phone off kar raha hoon.
13/03/26, 8:16 pm - Mahesh bhai: Maine database se entry erase kar di hai.
13/03/26, 8:23 pm - Nilesh bhai: Good, ab koi proof nahi hai unke paas.
13/03/26, 8:29 pm - Subhash bhai: Bas ab kal subah shop pe time se aana sab.
